description:
THE MECHANISM, pinned (2026-08-31; recipes: fz2 interp debug at 84ae179b4,
probes at define_return + all five CallEmission refine sites + the fact
table's two revision-bump sites, all reverted; enum_take_drop_split unless
noted, other fixtures scale proportionally):

analyze_activation pushes ReturnType(own key) into OUTPUTS unconditionally
on every eval (jobs/semantic.rs ~:261), including runs with NO return
evidence (define_return stores nothing, changed=false). The fact table
treats the first claim as first appearance: revision None -> 1 -- a CONTENT
movement for an EMPTY claim -- and wakes every reader. The reader re-reads
None evidence, concludes byte-identically: a zero-change eval. When real
evidence arrives later it lands as revision 1 -> 2.

Measured on 00420: 283 ReturnType first-claims, of which 135 are EMPTY
(store had no content); 62 genuine in-place content bumps (the real ascent,
via the joins); 1 readiness-only. All 197 stream-level 'bumps' reconcile
exactly as 62 real + 135 content-arrivals-after-empty-claims. The
zero-change eval class (192/85/171 per fixture, 24-37% of non-initial
analysis work) reads byte-identical raw values at EVERY consumption site
(verified across all five resolve paths) -- consistent with empty-claim
wakes plus the FunctionContract analog (65/30/33 zero-change causes; verify
the same claimed-before-derived idiom there as the first build step).

DEAD HYPOTHESES from this dig (do not re-walk): stale wakes (0 of 448
zero-change evals woken by an unread fact); meet-masking (0 raw-moved-
refined-same cases); join-absorption at the row merge (raw values identical,
nothing to absorb). ALSO: the fz-kdt.83 census's 'discovery 1' (ReturnType
never ascends in place) was a PROBE ARTIFACT -- the probe script aborted
before writing; real in-place bumps are 62. The census verdict stands on its
zero-change/lateral numbers, which this mechanism explains.

## The fix design (cold review before building)

'An evidence-less claim is not a content movement' -- unknown-is-not-none at
the claims layer. Options to weigh:
(a) DEFER THE CLAIM: don't list ReturnType in outputs until evidence exists.
    First-with-evidence claim = revision 1 = real content; readers of the
    absent fact record the read and wake on genuine first content. Hazards:
    Current-wait satisfaction (satisfies(Current) = revision present -- who
    WAITS on Current(ReturnType)? callers read, never wait, by the mutual-
    recursion rule; verify nothing else waits), retraction/claim-continuity
    semantics (kdt.63/69.1 interplay -- an unclaimed fact has nothing to
    preserve), and the settled gates (transport waits Settled(ReturnType)?
    check consumers).
(b) CLAIM WITHOUT MOVEMENT: presence without revision (a claimed-empty state
    distinct from revision-1 content -- a fact-table state extension; costs
    an engine concept, per the fz-kdt.74 review's standard).
(c) SUPPRESS THE WAKE only (empty claim's FactChange classified readiness/
    existence, not content -- touches the is_cumulative/shift algebra).
(a) is smallest and correct-by-construction if the wait/consumer sweep comes
back clean; (b)/(c) are fallbacks if something genuinely needs presence.

Expected win: the empty-claim wake per key (~135 on 00420) and the bulk of
zero-change re-runs (121/42/134 ReturnType-caused); plus the FunctionContract
analog if confirmed. Acceptance: zero-change evals measured down on all
three fixtures; zero-uncaused unweakened; inventory pins + canon
byte-compare hold; evals ratchet re-pinned downward with attribution.
title: Evidence-less claims are content movements: empty ReturnType claims wake readers of nothing
